rationale: The entry thesis of a mean-reversion bounce to VWAP has failed, as price has rejected the 9-EMA and is now trading below it, signaling a resumption of the downtrend. With the stock sitting near the session low and facing significant overhead resistance at the 9-EMA and VWAP, the risk of further downside toward the invalidation level outweighs the potential for a short-term recovery.
